## Here's how Scribe works

Hint: It’s incredibly easy!

[**Step 1: Capture any process** \\
Turn on the Scribe extension and go through your process like normal. Your step-by-step guide will be automatically created!](https://scribehow.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-0) [**Step 2: Easily customize** \\
Want to add more detail? Add text, edit screenshots, redact sensitive information and add your company’s branding.](https://scribehow.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-1) [**Step 3: Share with one click** \\
Share with teammates or clients via link, embed in company wikis and knowledge bases, or export to PDF.](https://scribehow.com/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-2)

## Create and share guides the easy way

Features that'll have you saying "where has this been all my life!?"

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/64766a6d9e49d3c3f7a96eb0_Thumbnail.webp)

#### Web & desktop process capture

Automatically create how-to guides for any web or desktop based process.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/64766a75fac84ab4dbde7553_Thumbnail-1.webp)

#### Automatic step instructions

No more manually typing instructions! Scribe automatically writes how-to guides.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/64766a7510620f6236202ca9_Thumbnail-2.webp)

#### AI-generated process documents

Use AI to generate SOPs, training manuals and process overviews for any process.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/646bbf59258bbec5fbbb33b6_feature-icon-4.svg)

#### Sensitive data redaction

Stay compliant by automatically redacting employee or customer data from screenshots.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/646bbf593e968e30a11b1180_feature-icon-5.svg)

#### Shareable links & PDF export

Share your guides however you need: via email, embed in your wiki or LMS, or export to PDF.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/615f415173b71a5211e28de7/646bbf59f8c07bb115000ca7_feature-icon-6.svg)

#### Custom branding

Add your company logo and colors to create on-brand, professional-looking guides.
